testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a sketch line color change: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:465:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a sketch line color change ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a dimensioned sketch is nested under an extrusion in the MCAD Software ✔ And its line color is Default ✔ When the user opens Properties from the sketch row context menu ✔ And the user opens the Line Color list ✔ Then the list offers Default, Black, Red, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue, Magenta and White ✔ And it offers a Select action ✔ When the user chooses Red ✔ Then the Line Color field displays Red and Apply is enabled ✔ When the user clicks Cancel and reopens the sketch properties ✔ Then the Line Color field displays Default and Apply is disabled ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the properties dialog closes
